outer_third_party_asset_notes.text:
Hello all!

This is the first selection of custom Noisevault synthetic impulses.

This collection concentrates mostly on vast lush spaces.

Everything in this collection was made by hand from purely synthetic
sources. By this I mean there are no 'real' spaces here, nor was my
intent to make impulses that would sound like a real space. These
impulses were designed to sound giant, smooth and luxurious.

They were hand made and edited at 192/64float (believe it or not) and
carefully converted to 44.1/32float.

Here are some usage notes:

1. These impulses are mostly quite long. This means your computer
might choke on some of them, and also they may not be appropriate for
conventional use as they stand. You should feel FREE to adjust the
length of these responses in your convolution tool, and to apply an
envelope to them. Even loading them up into your favorite two track
editor and editing them is a good idea! Of course, the reason I made
them long was so you could use them long if you wished.

2. Some of these impulses are NOT subtle. You may find that mixing
them quite low will sound excellent. The subtlety is in your hands.
Similar to the length, I wanted to give the headroom to mix these in
as strongly as you would like. But don't just listen to a 50/50 mix
when you judge them. :)

3. There is no pre delay built into any of these impulses. That too is
in YOUR hands. Reverb almost always sounds cooler if there is some
pre-delay that corresponds to the source, or even the size of the verb.
But you will need to tweak that too.

I really want to know what you folks think of these and if I should
try my hand at more!

James (cAPSLOCK) 
james@noisevault.com

outer_third_party_asset_notes.text:
Lexicon PCM91 Impulses:
---------------------------------------

This is a comprehensive collection of reverb-only presets from a Lexicon PCM91.  All halls, plates, rooms, and post production presets included.  No delay, gated, or special effect type presets are included, as these would have limited usefulness and can be easily accomplished using other plugins.

Recorded and edited in Sonar 3 at 24/44.1 via an M-Audio Delta1010 interface.    To take full advantage of the 24 bit resolution, make sure your recording software and audio card are also set to 24 bit depth as the tails will be much smoother as they approach the noise floor.

These reverb impulses I think capture the true character of a PCM91 better than any other impulses out there.  Classic Lexicon sound: wide and lush, gorgeous.  

Hope you get some good use out of these impulses, I've spent quite a few bleary-eyed late nights making them. Not to mention hours and hours of mind-numbing A/B comparisons with the actual unit.   

For a description of each preset visit http://www.lexiconpro.com/downloads/index.asp.   

Enjoy!



Lexicon PCM81 Impulses:
---------------------------------------

This is a collection of all the presets from the reverb section of the PCM81.  Obviously the modulation/chorus/pitch shift presets  would be of no use.   All recorded and edited in the same way as above.

These have a different character than the PCM91,  but are still definitely worth having in my opinion. Variety is a good thing! Enjoy!   

Any comments or feedback would be appreciated.

-Mark Blosser  (mblosser@neo.rr.com)
